# `get_cds_dcl`

Fetch CDS DCL access control source (DCLS) metadata, optionally including the source code.

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/get-cds-dcl.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/get-cds-dcl.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter       | Type      | Required | Description                                                             |
| --------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl`       | `string`  | no       | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000)                            |
| `client`        | `string`  | no       | SAP client number                                                       |
| `username`      | `string`  | no       | Username for basic auth                                                 |
| `password`      | `string`  | no       | Password for basic auth                                                 |
| `systemId`      | `string`  | no       | Logical system id (resolved via multi-system config or ~/.adt sessions) |
| `dclName`       | `string`  | yes      | DCL source name (e.g. ZDCL_SAMPLE)                                      |
| `includeSource` | `boolean` | no       | Include DCL source code                                                 |

_In destination mode every call additionally requires a `destination` key and rejects the connection fields (`baseUrl`, `client`, `username`, `password`, `systemId`)._

## Output

The tool returns a single text content item whose body is a JSON-serialised object (`content[0].text`). On error, the response has `isError: true` and a human-readable message.

```json
{
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)>" }]
}
```

See the source for the exact shape of `result`.

## Example invocation

```json
{
  "name": "get_cds_dcl",
  "arguments": {
    "baseUrl": "https://sap.example.com:44300",
    "username": "DEVELOPER",
    "password": "***",
    "client": "100",
    "dclName": "<dclName>"
  }
}
```

## Underlying contract

- `client.adt.ddic.dcl.sources.get`
- `client.adt.ddic.dcl.sources.source.main.get`
